notes.title: Version 2.0.86 Brazilian Portuguese Version!
notes.notes:
Hooray, friends from Brazil! Bronze Age is now available in your native language!
Wow, Bronze Age has 15 languages already, isn't it amazing?!

We hope you will enjoy the game and the great efforts of our volunteer translator! 
The translation was made by [url=https://crowdin.com/profile/ygbeira]Yuri Beira[/url] with the help of Crowdin.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30619541/504fc4a745e7e12ebd5b82d7f642e21acd5e7677.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 2.0.8. Norway and Ukrainian languages!
notes.notes:
Bronze Age got two more localizations! Thanks to our volunteers from Norway and Ukraine, more people are going to find our how did our ancestors live back in the Bronze Age!

That's it. That's the news. Want to see the game in your language? Welcome to join our Crowdin project: https://crowdin.com/project/bronze-age

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30619541/0cbf7a2a895db13fad730554b8566dcf8a919673.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 2.0.7 Czech localization
notes.notes:
Bronze Age 2.0.7 acquired the Czech localization! We're grateful to our volunteers and happy to know that the game will be available for yet another part of the world!

By the way, you're very welcome to participate in our translation project on [url=https://crowdin.com/project/bronze-age] Crowdin [/url]! Any language is welcome, but we're especially looking for Portuguese, Korean and Japanese translators. Every volunteer who finish the project will be mentioned in the credits and will get the certificate of gratitude from our company (if they wish). Join us!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30619541/ef8af9d16e79d3bc133183ed39292ecd8c9cd266.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bronze Age: version 2.0.6.0 German language
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thanks to our amazing volunteers Bronze Age is now available in the German language as well! To put it officially:

Bronze Age update 2.0.6.0:
- The German language is added;
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30619541/452fd91eafb9c61aa775dc08aed5302d6801f5bf.png[/img]

We already have BA available in 9 languages! Fantastic!
